method: Whole-file manual reading of MainFrame.cpp plus targeted reread of previously reviewed WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp quiet-export branches1280..1313. Pinned MainFrame bytes verified.
findings: Quiet-export exit is implemented in model actions, not MainFrame: after finalization save results/duplicates/permissions maps writer boolean to process0/1, with missing root failing1. This verifies source exit policy, not actual artifact content or completeness of every scan.

OnClose marks shutting down, aborts/waits scan, joins cleanup thread through UI-pumping helper, stops icon queue and then closes frame. Persistent attributes captured before child destruction, properties written after nonclient teardown. No bounded wait proof.

InvokeInMessageThread executes directly on owner thread or synchronously sends callback pointer. Stack callback lifetime relies on SendMessage synchrony; target-window failure/teardown is not reported here.

Progress uses range0when following mount/junction/symlink roots and changes taskbar100percent to indeterminate until finalization. Displayed100percent is explicitly not completion. Percentage multiplication m_progressPos*100uses u64 without explicit overflow check; realistic viewport/scan counterexample not tested.

Timer runs every25ms, with less frequent sorting every15ticks, avoids updates during shutdown and calls pending heap cleanup. This scheduling is not a throughput, responsiveness or memory-bound measurement.

Splitter positions derive double ratios with only partial input guards; restore can reset collapsed user positions. Invalid/nonfinite persisted values depend on upstream validation already reviewed, not these arithmetic casts.

Settings sheet creates eight lazy pages; restart confirmation cancel rejects applying, no records refusal for subsequent apply prompts, yes can exit sheet after apply. Declining restart still allows settings commit.
limits: No Windows export run, artifact parsing, partial-scan status test, shutdown, synchronous callback, progress overflow or persistence runtime tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
